messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot readiness checklist & Dedicated inference notes

Hi Emily — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps to get the Dedicated pilot moving.

Summary of pain points you shared:
- Variable peak traffic that spikes 3x during business hours and causes timeouts for important UX flows.
- Need for isolation (customer data + regulatory contracts) — you prefer a reserved pool vs. noisy-neighbor shared endpoints.
- Current infra struggles with predictable latency at P50/P95 under production mixes (inference + reranking).

Current stack you mentioned:
- GKE with Triton serving frames, custom autoscaler, and a light gateway for routing.
- Models: Llama2-based family (some quantized variants), most production requests ~avg 350 tokens.

Success criteria for the pilot (proposal):
- P50 latency < 350ms, P95 < 900ms for the primary prompt template at 80% of peak traffic.
- Predictable throughput: sustain 60 QPS baseline, absorb bursts to 150 QPS via burst policy.
- No production data exfiltration; traffic remains inside your VPC (Private deployment).
- Cost estimate within the range you indicated (we'll crunch exact numbers after sizing).

Proposed Dedicated pilot configuration:
- Reserved GPU pool: 3 x A100-80GB nodes (start); telemetry-driven scale guidance to 5 nodes if sustained queue or GPU >85% for 2 minutes.
- Autoscaling / burst policy: automatic short-term burst to shared capacity for spikes <10 minutes, with rate-limits and fallbacks to smaller models as a graceful degradation path.
- KV-prefix caching for repeated prompts; we recommend enabling prefix cache for your most common prompt templates.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm required pilot kickoff window: we propose Tue Dec 15 or Wed Dec 16 (30–45m).
2) Share a small sample of representative payloads (sanitized) and an eval set — we will use these for a synthetic load run.
3) Provide the region preference (us-west1 / us-east1) and KMS provider for encryption key access.
4) I'll attach a one-page SOW + pilot scope draft for review (attached).

Attachments: pilot_scope_draft.pdf, redwood_security_onepager.pdf

If that all looks right I’ll follow up with Monica to line up the technical kickoff and send an initial sizing doc. Thanks — Alex

--

Thanks Alex — appreciate the clear recap. Quick clarifications from our side (adding detail so your sizing is accurate):

- Model & runtime: primary model is Llama2-70B Q4 (we run a 4-bit quant variant in prod), fallback to a 13B distilled variant for cost-sensitive paths.
- Typical payloads: avg. prompt length ~360 tokens, response avg ~180 tokens. Burst traffic today hits ~120 QPS sustained for up to 6–8 minutes during report generation windows; baseline steady-state ~28 QPS.
- Security/regulatory: SOC2 required, customer data must remain in our VPC (we will require a Private deployment option). We use Google KMS (GCP) and have strict key policies.
- KPIs: pilot success means we can route 80% of production traffic to Dedicated with <=10% cost delta vs. current spend and meeting latency SLOs.

We can provide a sanitized eval set and example payloads by EOD tomorrow. Dec 15 works for kickoff — prefer morning (US PST). I’ll loop in procurement for the SOW review.

Emily — Monica here (solutions eng). A few technical clarifications so we size the pool correctly and set the right autoscale triggers. If you can answer any of the below before the kickoff, it will speed the pilot: 

1) Average & 95th percentile prompt token lengths (you gave avg ~360; can you share p95?), and any heavy outlier templates (e.g., code generation prompts that are 2–3x longer).
2) Typical concurrency per user session and whether requests are bursty (many small requests) or fewer long requests.
3) Do you currently batch requests on the client side or at gateway? If batching exists we can optimize kernel selection for throughput.
4) Can you share a small representative eval set (we only need ~100–200 examples) and a sample tokenization map (if you have custom tokenization)?
5) Network constraints: are there IP allowlists or a firewall/gateway we must route through during the pilot?

Technical notes for your team:
- For Llama2-70B Q4 we expect memory headroom to be tight on A100-80GB unless you use sharded/offload patterns; H100 or multi-node sharding improves latency vs. a single large node.
- We recommend enabling KV cache for sessions where users iterate on prompts — that reduces repeated compute for prefix tokens and can cut avg latency by ~20–35% depending on workload.

I’ll compile answers into a short sizing appendix and attach to the SOW before the kickoff.

Thanks — Monica
